events.name: The Music of Bobby Darin and Paul Anka
events.info: Welcome to the world of timeless melodies and unforgettable performances. Remember a time when two great entertainers, Bobby Darin and Paul Anka, wowed audiences with the soundtracks of our lives. They were showmen in the best sense of the term. Now be prepared to be mesmerized by the captivating vocals and magnetic stage presence of two talented showmen, Lou Villano and Ron Gartner, who, with their band, embody the spirit and charisma that made Anka and Darin such icons. Your ticket includes our house greens salad with choice of dressing, basket of dinner rolls with butter, and a selection of entrée options, along with coffee and water. All other drinks such as alcohol, soda, tea, starters, entrée upgrades and desserts are available for purchase during your Ingersoll dining experience. Dining begins TWO HOURS before showtime.

events.name: Our House - A Tribute to Crosby, Stills, Nash & Young
events.info: Prepare for an unparalleled musical experience as "OUR HOUSE: The Music of CSNY" assembles to perform the Crosby, Stills, Nash & Young repertoire with an extraordinary ensemble of FAMILY & FRIENDS. OUR HOUSE brings together a musical lineage that resonates with the very heart of Crosby, Stills, Nash & Young's legacy. The combined talents of these remarkable artists promise an authentic and soulful rendition of the iconic tunes that have transcended generations, standing the test of time. Your ticket includes our house greens salad with choice of dressing, basket of dinner rolls with butter, and a selection of entrée options, along with coffee, tea, and water. All other drinks such as alcohol, soda, starters, entrée upgrades and desserts are available for purchase during your Ingersoll dining experience. Dining begins TWO HOURS before showtime.
events.pleaseNote: **Timing of Dinner: Dinner seating begins 90 MINUTES before show time. *For a 1:00 pm matinee performance, please arrive between 11:30am and 12:00pm. *For a 7:30 pm evening performance, please arrive between 6:00pm and 6:30pm. **Dinner: Every ticket to The Ingersoll includes a delicious dining experience. Enjoy your meal in the theater before the show, making your night truly unforgettable. **Club Seating: Tables 38-49 are Club Level seats upstairs and can be accessed using the stairs or the lift. Tables 42 through 49 are high-top tables. The Club Level has a private bar and private restrooms. **Seating Information: Our venue has cabaret seating, which means that you and your party may be sharing a table with other guests. When purchasing your tickets, please purchase seats across from each other (i.e. seats 1 and 2, 3 and 4, or 5 and 6). **Children: While family friendly shows are available, infants are not permitted in the theater. Children ages 5 and older are welcome.
